$comment: Output shape for one tagged review. One JSON object per review_id, collected into an array per batch file. skill_version bumps whenever taxonomy.md or this schema changes in a way that invalidates prior tags.

record_shape.review_id: string, copied from the input batch row, unchanged
record_shape.is_foodhub: boolean — false only if this review is clearly not about the Foodhub marketplace app (rare)

aspects.severity: integer 1-3, only when sentiment=negative, else null
aspects.evidence_quote: short verbatim snippet (<=200 chars) from the review text supporting this tag
